instruction: A candid documentary wide shot captures an indoor motion capture studio featuring a red carpet, white walls, and technical equipment. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands facing right, reaching her hand toward the man's shoulder. On the right, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left, looking directly at her. The room is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor. The camera is positioned at eye level, capturing both subjects in full-body view.
